customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be the best in the market with a premium appearance and user-friendly app interface. They appreciate its adjustable TDS levels, good taste without metallic or chemical aftertaste, and excellent installation process. The value for money receives mixed reviews, with some finding the filter prices reasonable while others express regret about their purchase.

reviews.author: Pradeep Kandaswamy
reviews.title: Atomberg Intellon - Great versatile purifier with smart TDS-based RO — recommended
reviews.body: Installed the Atomberg Intellon RO today (August 10, 2026), and overall, Very happy with the Atomberg Intellon so far. The TDS-based switching is a smart feature that reduces RO usage when it isn’t needed. This should help reduce wastewater while retaining more minerals, especially with the alkaliser. The water tastes clean and slightly alkaline, and the 8L tank is sufficient for our family of four. The technician installed a Pressure Reducing Value (PRV) free-of-cost as the input pressure was slightly high. The app monitoring and alerts work well, although the initial setup took a few minutes

reviews.author: Srinath S
reviews.title: Good
reviews.body: The Atomberg Intellion RO performs well in terms of water purification. The design is modern, water quality is good, and the smart app features are useful when they work. Installation was smooth, and the purifier provides useful information such as filter status and water quality through the app. However, the biggest drawback is Wi-Fi management. If you change your home Wi-Fi name or router, reconnecting the purifier can be frustrating. reviews.body: Atomberg Water purifier was very nice display design and Purification method then value for money. Water quality was good. But Price and size little bit high.

reviews.author: Noor
reviews.title: Excellent Product & Great Service
reviews.body: I have been using this Atomberg water purifier for the past 6 months and I’m very happy with its performance. The water quality and taste are good, and the purifier has been working reliably without any issues. The after-sales service is also excellent. The service team is responsive, professional, and helpful whenever assistance is needed. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the product and the service. Definitely worth considering if you’re looking for a reliable water purifier. Highly recommended! 👍
